reference_uncertainty.description: Spread between the two transcriptions of the same figure
reference_uncertainty.interpretation: The reference itself is uncertain to ~31.9% of amplitude

ritter_deviation.description: Mean absolute deviation from Ritter shallow-water solution
ritter_deviation.interpretation: Ritter overpredicts the front speed; SPH is more realistic

error_budget.interpretation: The total MAE/amplitude is 4.38%. The reference uncertainty alone accounts for ~31.9%. The Ritter deviation is 84.5%. The compressibility error is 1.94% of rho0. The residual (-27.48%) is attributable to discretization and boundary condition effects.

resolution_trend.interpretation: The bias changes sign 1 time(s) across the ladder. The minimum MAE/amplitude is 1.65%, which is the resolution-independent component (not discretization error). The non-monotone trend is caused by the bias crossing zero, not by a failure of convergence.
